title: Individual Beliefs, Demand for Currency, and Exchange Rate Dynamics
title_zh: 个体信念、货币需求与汇率动态
authors: Vania Stavrakeva, Jenny Tang, Constantin Burgi, Prachi Srivastava, Karl Whelan 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper, we build a general equilibrium model that takes the institutional details of the foreign exchange market into account and allows for deviations from full information rational expectations (FIRE) in a way consistent with forecast survey data and traders’ asset positions. We show that the testable implications of this model — related to foreign exchange derivatives positions, and both realized and expected exchange rates — are strongly supported in the data. Moreover, we argue that the particular form of deviation from FIRE implied by the data can help resolve important exchange rate puzzles, such as the Fama puzzle and the delayed overshooting puzzle, and can generate hump-shaped dynamics of exchange rates.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，该模型考虑了外汇市场的制度细节，并以与预测调查数据和交易者资产头寸一致的方式，允许偏离完全信息理性预期（FIRE）。我们证明，该模型的可检验含义——涉及外汇衍生品头寸、已实现汇率和预期汇率——在数据中得到了有力支持。此外，我们认为，数据所隐含的偏离FIRE的特定形式，有助于解决重要的汇率谜题，例如Fama谜题和延迟超调谜题，并能产生汇率的驼峰形动态特征。

title: Macro Shocks and Firm Dynamics with Oligopolistic Financial Intermediaries
title_zh: 寡头金融中介下的宏观冲击与企业动态
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Motivated by a secular increase in the concentration of the U.S. banking industry, I develop a new macroeconomic model with oligopolistic financial intermediaries and heterogeneous firms. Market power allows banks to price discriminate and charge firm-specific markups, exerting greater market power over productive and more financially constrained firms. This dampens capital accumulation and amplifies the effects of macroeconomic shocks. During a crisis, banks exploit the higher share of financially constrained firms to extract higher markups, inducing a larger decline in real activity. When a large bank fails, the remaining banks use their increased market power to restrict credit supply, worsening and prolonging the downturn.
abstract_zh: 受美国银行业集中度长期上升的启发，本文构建了一个包含寡头金融中介与异质性企业的新型宏观经济模型。市场势力使银行能够实施价格歧视，对异质性企业收取差异化加成率，对生产率更高且融资约束更强的企业施加更大的市场势力。这一机制抑制了资本积累，并放大了宏观经济冲击的影响。危机期间，银行利用融资约束企业占比上升的机会提取更高加成率，导致实际经济活动更大幅度下滑。当大型银行倒闭时，幸存银行凭借增强的市场势力限制信贷供给，加剧并延长经济衰退。

title: An Empirical Framework for Platform Markets
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Quantifying merger effects and conducting other counterfactual analyses is often difficult in platform markets because direct and indirect network effects link demand within and across market sides. We develop a general empirical framework for two-sided markets that incorporates these effects within an otherwise standard empirical IO approach. The framework does not impose a particular demand specification: researchers can estimate flexible demand systems on each side, for example, using BLP-type demand on one side or both. We allow direct and indirect network effects to vary across groups. Standard one-sided merger simulation emerges as a special case when network effects are absent. We provide sufficient conditions for uniqueness in the coordination game within and across market sides and for existence and uniqueness in the firms’ pricing game. These conditions are testable. When these conditions hold, the framework supports recovery of marginal costs from firms’ first-order conditions and can be used to conduct counterfactual analysis, including merger simulation.
abstract_zh: 在平台市场中，量化并购效应及开展其他反事实分析往往较为困难，因为直接和间接网络效应将市场内及跨市场的需求相互关联。我们为双边市场构建了一个通用实证框架，在保留标准实证产业组织方法的基础上，将这些效应纳入其中。该框架不强制设定特定的需求函数形式：研究者可在各市场侧估计灵活的需求系统，例如在一侧或双侧采用BLP型需求模型。我们允许直接和间接网络效应在不同群体间存在差异。当不存在网络效应时，标准单边市场并购模拟即成为该框架的特例。我们为市场内及跨市场协调博弈的唯一性，以及企业定价博弈的存在性与唯一性提供了充分条件，这些条件均可检验。当这些条件成立时，该框架支持从企业一阶条件中反推边际成本，并可用于开展包括并购模拟在内的反事实分析。

title: Determinants of Sovereign Bond Issuance in Emerging Markets
title_zh: 新兴市场主权债券发行的决定因素
authors: Wong, Ka Lok, Manger, Mark, Panizza, Ugo, Panizza, Ugo Gianluigi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) regularly tap domestic and international capital markets through scheduled sovereign bond auctions. In this paper, we leverage a novel dataset covering over 75,000 sovereign issuance events and 20,000 securities from 20 EMEs between the early 2000s and 2023 to analyze the determinants of bond issuance choices, focusing on volume, maturity, and currency denomination. We find that local currency debt issuance is largely associated with refinancing needs, while foreign currency issuance reflects more strategic and cyclical considerations. In particular, foreign currency issuance correlates with global macroeconomic conditions, interest rate differentials, and investor sentiment. Our findings suggest that EME governments differentiate their debt management strategies based on the currency of issuance, with local currency issuance shaped by domestic budget mechanics and foreign currency issuance by external constraints and opportunities.
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）通过定期主权债券拍卖，持续进入国内和国际资本市场。本文利用2000年代初至2023年间覆盖20个新兴市场经济体超过75,000次主权发行事件及20,000只证券的新数据集，分析债券发行选择的决定因素，重点关注发行规模、期限和货币计价。研究发现，本币债券发行主要与再融资需求相关，而外币债券发行则更多反映战略性和周期性考量。具体而言，外币债券发行与全球宏观经济状况、利率差异及投资者情绪存在关联。研究结果表明，新兴市场经济体政府会根据发行货币差异化其债务管理策略：本币发行受国内预算机制驱动，外币发行则受外部约束与机遇影响。

title: Concentrating or dispersing? The impact of supplier concentration on lean inventory
title_zh: 集中还是分散？供应商集中度对精益库存的影响
authors: Yang Xu, Yun Che, Yi Sun, Ziang Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Supplier concentration can enhance resource integration efficiency, but it may also increase dependency risks. Therefore, concerning inventory management, which supply chain structure is more advantageous: diversification or centralization? We utilize data from publicly listed firms in China from 2010 to 2024 to empirically examine the impact of supplier concentration on firms’ lean inventory and its potential mechanisms. The results indicate that supplier concentration generally has a positive effect on firms in promoting lean inventory, thereby supporting the theoretical assumptions dominated by transaction cost economics and embeddedness theory. In addition, from the perspectives of information flow, production flow, and capital flow, we verify that supplier concentration promotes lean inventory in firms by reducing coordination costs, alleviating financing constraints, and enhancing total factor productivity. Focusing on the resource dependence theory, we find that corporate strategy, R&D innovation, and regional marketization of firms amplify the positive effect of supplier concentration on lean inventory. Finally, analysis of segmented inventory type data indicates that supplier concentration significantly drives lean practices in raw materials and work-in-progress inventory, while its impact on lean practices related to finished goods inventory is limited.
abstract_zh: 供应商集中度能够提升资源整合效率，但也可能增加依赖风险。因此，在库存管理方面，供应链结构究竟是多元化还是集中化更具优势？我们利用2010至2024年中国上市公司数据，实证检验供应商集中度对企业精益库存的影响及其潜在机制。结果表明，供应商集中度总体上对企业推进精益库存具有正向效应，从而支持了以交易成本经济学和嵌入性理论为主导的理论假设。此外，从信息流、生产流和资金流视角出发，我们验证了供应商集中度通过降低协调成本、缓解融资约束以及提升全要素生产率来促进企业精益库存。基于资源依赖理论，我们发现企业战略、研发创新及区域市场化程度会放大供应商集中度对精益库存的正向效应。最后，对细分库存类型数据的分析表明，供应商集中度显著推动了原材料和在制品库存的精益实践，但对产成品库存精益实践的影响有限。

title: Depression stigma
authors: Christopher Roth, Peter Schwardmann, Egon Tripodi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: People with mental illness are frequently discriminated against and stigmatized. We introduce a new measure of perceived depression stigma and examine the causal effect of perceived stigma on help-seeking in a sample of 1844 Americans suffering from depression. We document that a large majority of our participants overestimate the extent of stigma associated with depression. An informational intervention aimed at reducing perceived social stigma decreases the demand for psychotherapy. Merely prompting individuals to think about stigma has a similar effect. A mechanism experiment reveals that our interventions increase both participants’ optimism about future mental health and their readiness to rely on friends and family, thereby reducing the perceived need for therapy.
abstract_zh: 精神疾病患者常遭受歧视与污名化。我们引入了一种新的感知抑郁污名测量方法，并在1844名患有抑郁症的美国样本中，考察了感知污名对求助行为的因果效应。研究发现，绝大多数参与者高估了与抑郁症相关的污名程度。一项旨在降低感知社会污名的信息干预措施，减少了对心理治疗的需求。仅提示个体思考污名问题，也产生了类似效果。机制实验表明，我们的干预措施既提升了参与者对未来心理健康的乐观程度，也增强了他们依赖亲友的意愿，从而降低了对治疗必要性的感知。

title: The unexpected role of conditionality in shaping relational values: Insights from an incentive-based conservation program in Bolivia
title_zh: 条件性在塑造关系价值中的意外作用：来自玻利维亚激励型保护项目的证据
authors: Brooke McWherter, Will Munger, Zhao Ma, Claudia Radel, Laura Zanotti 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As global change accelerates, Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) programs have become increasingly important tools for addressing the interconnected challenges of land degradation, biodiversity loss, water scarcity, and climate change. PES programs provide incentives to individuals or communities, conditional on people adopting sustainable natural resource management practices to support or increase ecosystem service provisioning. Although conditionality is considered a “PES-defining feature,” little is known about how conditionality is perceived by community members and how such perceptions influence their participation in and experience with PES programs. To address this gap, we conducted an extensive qualitative study of Watershared, a Bolivian PES program, to investigate (1) how community members perceive conditionality in PES and its two components—monitoring and sanction, and (2) how removing conditionality influences PES participants’ perceptions of the program and relationship with the implementing organization. We found that Watershared participants perceived monitoring as more than just a compliance check mechanism; they saw it as a form of technical support and relationship building, which strengthens their relational values toward both nature and the program itself. Participants were generally unconcerned about sanctioning, with many viewing sanctioning as unnecessary or unenforceable, despite the implementing organization having imposed sanctions previously. Watershared participants with unconditional contracts generally noticed the removal of conditionality, with some interpreting it as a lack of care and reciprocity from the implementing organization. These results highlight how relational values were developed and supported through the two components of conditionality in PES. These results suggest that the role of conditionality in PES may be less about surveillance and penalty to ensure conservation, but more about serving as an avenue to activate and strengthen community members’ relational values toward nature and the PES-implementing organization, which may, in turn, improve program effectiveness and future participation. In the face of intensifying global environmental change, such relational values tied to conditionality in PES, as identified in this research, are critical for fostering and sustaining cooperation, trust, and long-term commitment to conservation.
abstract_zh: 随着全球变化加速，生态系统服务付费（PES）项目已成为应对土地退化、生物多样性丧失、水资源短缺和气候变化等相互关联挑战的重要工具。PES项目向个人或社区提供激励，条件是他们采取可持续自然资源管理实践，以支持或增加生态系统服务供给。尽管条件性被视为“PES的定义性特征”，但关于社区成员如何感知条件性，以及这种感知如何影响他们参与PES项目并形成相关体验，目前知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对玻利维亚的Watershared PES项目进行了广泛的定性研究，旨在探究：（1）社区成员如何感知PES中的条件性及其两个组成部分——监测与制裁；（2）取消条件性如何影响PES参与者对项目的看法及其与实施组织的关系。我们发现，Watershared参与者将监测视为不仅仅是合规检查机制，更将其视为一种技术支持和关系建设形式，这强化了他们对自然和项目本身的关联价值。参与者普遍不关心制裁，许多人认为制裁不必要或无法执行，尽管实施组织此前曾施加过制裁。拥有无条件合同的Watershared参与者通常注意到条件性的取消，其中一些人将其解读为实施组织缺乏关怀和互惠。这些结果凸显了关联价值如何通过PES条件性的两个组成部分得以发展和支持。这些结果表明，PES中条件性的作用可能不在于通过监督和惩罚来确保保护，而更多是作为激活和加强社区成员对自然及PES实施组织的关联价值的途径，这进而可能提升项目有效性和未来参与度。面对日益加剧的全球环境变化，本研究所识别的与PES条件性相关的关联价值，对于培养和维持合作、信任以及对保护的长期承诺至关重要。

title: International Trade Finance and Learning Dynamics
title_zh: 国际贸易融资与学习动态
authors: Kohn, David, Luttini, Emiliano Evaristo, Szkup, Michal, Zhang, Shengxing
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines the relationship between the Financial Health Index of Brazilians (Índice de Saúde Financeira do Brasileiro, I-SFB) and credit behavior, focusing on two central questions: (1) how different levels of financial health relate to the likelihood of delinquency, and (2) how transitions between stages of late payments and delinquency vary according to the financial health levels measured by the I-SFB. The results reveal a significant association between higher I-SFB scores and a lower likelihood of delinquency, with the financial behavior and financial security dimensions showing the strongest link to reduced risk. The study also highlights potential improvements to the financial skills dimension, which showed no significant relationship with delinquency. A revision of the items comprising this dimension is put forth, incorporating more practical aspects of financial knowledge application. For the private sector, the study proposes using the I-SFB as a diagnostic tool to develop new financial products that are better aligned with the population’s needs, thereby fostering more robust financial health. The implementation of integrated strategies, combining behavioral interventions, practical financial education, and consumer protection policies, is essential to achieve more sustainable outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究关系专用性学习如何影响出口与贸易融资的联合动态。基于智利微观企业数据，本文发现新出口商最初依赖预付款交易，随着贸易关系成熟逐步转向提供贸易信贷，且在风险更高的目的地及经验较少的企业中，这一转型速度更快。受此现象启发，本文构建了一个整合外国需求与交易对手风险学习机制、以及企业内生出口与贸易融资选择的一般均衡贸易模型。该模型用于探究学习机制与风险在塑造出口调整中的作用，并量化贸易融资成本冲击对总出口的影响。分析表明，出口对上述冲击的反应取决于目的地的风险水平，且长期贸易关系的中断会放大这种影响。
